newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures end higher, cash supportive.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures end higher, cash supportive.

text.p: A late round of commission house buying erased declines in nearby CME lumber futures and November and January contracts closed higher.
Traders said buying continued to be linked to strong cash prices and ongoing concerns a slowdown in Canadian exports to the U.S. will result in tight deliverable supplies.
Shipments from Canada were expected to slow as export quotas are met.
Lumber closed up $2.70 per thousand board foot to down $0.50 with November up the most at $418.20 per tbf.
